summary_reason: The core issue is a fundamental misunderstanding of how '情報セキュリティ' (information security) relates to accounting terminology. It is not an item that is '計上' (booked/recorded) or has a '残高' (balance) in the same way financial accounts do. The examples and dialogue incorrectly apply accounting predicates to an abstract concept. The collocations are fine, but the application in sentences is flawed.
